text:
sara: Heads-up — want to run the rollout for model `sentinel-4.1` tomorrow night in the 03:00-05:00 UTC change window. Main asks: fallback ordering, pin TTL, and rollback playbook.
sara: Proposed plan: canary 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 90m, prefix cache priming, pin list includes stable-3.8 as immediate fallback.
jordan: +1. Do we have latency SLO guards for that variant? We saw a small tail increase on 4.0 in staging.
lee: Sentinel-4.1 perf looked fine in perf-run but we need the safety gate `sentinel_regression_suite` green before 10% cutover. Also set the fallback priority as: stable-3.8, quant-3.8-q, stable-3.6.
mike: Rollback checklist: immediate pin to stable-3.8 + traffic shift to 0% for sentinel-4.1, abort canary, and open an incident if error-rate > 1% for 15m. I can own the first-15m watch.
sara: Good. Can deploy-bot schedule and publish the rollout notes in #eng-releases and attach the rollout checklist?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created by sara
- model: sentinel-4.1
- change window: 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z - 2026-03-22T05:00:00Z
- initial canary: 2% at 03:15Z
- canary progression: 2% -> 10% @ 03:45Z -> 30% @ 04:30Z
- safety gates: `sentinel_regression_suite` (qa), latency SLO check, error-rate check
- fallback order: stable-3.8, quant-3.8-q, stable-3.6
- pin TTL: 24h default (override allowed)

deploy-bot: To force a pin now run: ```rexctl catalog pin set --model sentinel-4.1 --ttl 24h --reason "pre-rollout"```

ops-bot: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-rollout-checklist (added to thread)

jordan: Quick Q: pin TTL 24h ok? If we need to emergency-reset traffic after rollback, shorter TTL helps avoid accidental long pins.
sara: Let's set default 24h but explicitly set 6h on canary pin so we don't accidentally hold traffic. I'll update the checklist.
lee: Also add an eviction guard: do not evict quant-3.8-q instances until after 30m post-cutover if it becomes fallback — avoids cold-start thundering.
mike: I added the rollback snippet to the incident template: ```rexctl catalog pin set --model stable-3.8 --force && rexctl routing set-traffic --model sentinel-4.1 0```
sara: OK locking in: canary at 03:15Z, 6h canary-pin TTL, safety gate must pass before 10% cutover. Mike watches first 15m, Jordan monitors latency, Lee monitors PS-queue. I'll post release notes after deploy-bot confirms start. :thumbsup:
lee: ack
jordan: ack
mike: ack
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout will POST to #eng-releases at start time and emit per-stage events. Subscribe with `rexctl watch rollout 1766012345`
sara: thanks everyone — closing thread unless something blocks.
